newsitem.title: USA: Pamplin group cuts Dixie Yarns stake.
newsitem.headline: Pamplin group cuts Dixie Yarns stake.

text.p: A group led by Portland, Ore., investor Robert Pamplin said Tuesday it reduced its stake in Dixie Yarns Inc to 2.71 percent or 429,600 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 117,000 shares of Dixie between September 17 and November 14 at prices ranging from $4.9375 to $6.00 a share.
Pamplin is chairman of a R.B. Pamplin Co, parent of Mount Vernon Mills Inc. Dixie Yarns is a Chattanooga, Tenn., textile company.
